claim: *The Admission Funnel, One Mature Week.* Merge-train runs in the mature era's highest-throughput full week: 592 started, 573 landed on main through the full integration gate, 10 aborted, 192 work spaces retired. Parallel realization fanned out; admission stayed serialized through regenerated evidence. The registry logs only this stage — upstream repair iterations are not retained as events.
topology: Quantitative axes preserve source values and categories.
bw_encoding: Explicit labels, distinct markers and monochrome patterns; no color-only distinction.
redesign: Same maximum-completion week 2026-W35; categorical bars do not imply retirement is a sequential funnel stage. Restored external units and interpretive annotations at 10 pt.
